content.comment_body: Could you explain how to connect the maximum number of expansion modules to the [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]?

The number of analog inputs you utilize on the basic module determines its expansion capacity. A [product_name] [version_no] can handle up to 8 analog inputs. The [product_name] [version_no] comes with 4 analog inputs (0-10V). If all 4 onboard analog inputs are used, you can still connect 2 more expansion modules for additional analog inputs. For analog outputs, the [product_name] [version_no] can also support up to 8 total, as the basic module itself has none. Therefore, you can connect up to 4 expansion modules for analog outputs.
